title: Projektmanager:in Social & Creator Marketing (Intermediate) (w/m/d)
text:
Social Media ist voll von Content. Aber nur ein Teil davon bewegt wirklich etwas.

Genau daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag. Mit Strategien, Creator:innen und Ideen, die nicht nur Reichweite bringen, sondern Wirkung.

Und genau dafür suchen wir dich!

Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung von Social- und Creator-Marketing-Kampagnen
  • Zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für Kund:innen während laufender Projekte
  • Koordination von Creators, Partnern und internen Teams
  • Erstellung von Projektplänen, Timelines und Budgets sowie deren Überwachung
  • Qualitätssicherung von Content und Kampagnenausspielung
  • Analyse und Reporting von Kampagnenergebnissen inkl. Ableitung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse und Workflows
  • Unterstützung bei der strategischen Konzeption von Kampagnen

Qualifikation

  • 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Social Media oder Influencer Marketing
  • Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren parallelen Projekten und Prioritäten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Budgets und Verantwortung für deren Einhaltung
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Organisationstalent
  • Erste Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. Asana, Notion, Monday)
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Wir legen viel Wert auf ein Umfeld, in dem man gerne arbeitet - mit einem Team, das zusammenhält und Bock hat, Dinge voranzubringen.

  • Ambitioniertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien, viel Vertrauen und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Spannende Projekte, bei denen du sichtbar etwas bewegen kannst
  • Flexibles Arbeiten inkl. Remote-Option (bis zu 12 Wochen/Jahr)
  • 30 Tage Urlaub & 38h-Woche
  • Apple-Equipment auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Givve Card oder Wellpass
  • Jobrad & betriebliche Altersvorsorge

title: Team Lead – ERP Basis & Development (w/m/d)
text:
WICHTIG: Wer keine hohe Reisebereitschaft hat, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine SAP‑Basis‑Rolle, du willst die strategische Steuerung eines globalen ERP‑Ökosystems. Du willst Verantwortung für internationale Roll‑outs, ein Team führen und dabei ein attraktives Gehalt von bis zu 110 k € genießen. Hier geht es nicht um reine Administration, hier geht es um die konsequente Weiterentwicklung von SAP S/4HANA in über 24 Standorten weltweit. Hier geht es um Führung, internationale Reisetätigkeit und die Chance, deine Karriere in einem stabilen Unternehmen mit 30 Urlaubstagen und Hybrid‑Modell zu pushen.

Unser Kunde

Ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Befestigungssysteme für Rohrleitungen und Anlagenbau mit über 900 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 24 Standorten auf drei Kontinenten. Das Unternehmen entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt modulare Lösungen und gilt als etablierter Marktführer mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung. Es legt großen Wert auf Sicherheit, Wertschätzung und offene Zusammenarbeit.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hohe Vergütung von 70 k € bis 110 k € plus 14. Gehalt – finanzielle Anerkennung deiner Expertise.

  • Internationale ERP‑Roll‑outs in über 20 Ländern – globale Sichtbarkeit und interkulturelle Erfahrung.

  • Führungsverantwortung für ein komplettes SAP‑S/4HANA‑Team – Gestaltungsspielraum von Basis bis Development.

  • Hybrid‑Arbeitsmodell mit zwei Home‑Office‑Tagen pro Woche – Flexibilität und Work‑Life‑Balance.

  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsprogramme und klare Karrierepfade – kontinuierliche persönliche Entwicklung.

  • Stabiler Marktführer mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung – Sicherheit und langfristige Perspektive.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Weiterentwicklung der ERP‑Basis & Development: Support, Systemadministration, Authorisierungen, Entwicklung & Integration.

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen Betriebs und kontinuierlicher Optimierung von SAP S/4HANA.

  • Planung und Durchführung internationaler SAP‑Roll‑outs inklusive Ressourcen‑ und Budgetverantwortung.

  • Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Koordination mit Fachbereichen zur Prozessoptimierung.

  • Erstellung von Status‑Reports für das Management und das Head of Business Development.

  • Mentoring und Entwicklung des internen ERP‑Teams sowie Verantwortung für disziplinarische Führung.

  • Integration von Formularen und Supply‑Chain‑Modulen in das Gesamtsystem.

  • Überwachung von System‑Uptime und Performance‑Kennzahlen.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in einem internationalen Umfeld.

  • Erfolgreiche Leitung von ERP‑Roll‑outs und Projektmanagement nach PMI‑ oder vergleichbarem Standard.

  • Erfahrung in disziplinarischer Führung von Teams (mind. 3 Mitarbeitende) oder Projektleitung.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift.

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft für internationale Einsätze (mehrere Wochen pro Jahr).

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in weiteren ERP‑Systemen (z. B. Ramsauer & Stürmer) von Vorteil.

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Keine praktische SAP S/4HANA‑Erfahrung – fehlende Fachkompetenz.

  • Fehlende Führungserfahrung – keine Fähigkeit zur Team‑ und Projektleitung.

  • Geringe Reisebereitschaft – internationale Roll‑outs nicht machbar.

  • Unzureichende Deutsch‑ oder Englischkenntnisse – Kommunikation scheitert.

  • Nur reine Theoriekenntnisse ohne operative Umsetzung – kein Mehrwert.

Deine Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit Jahresgehalt 70 k

title: B2B Sales & Business Development Manager • SaaS für börsennotierte AGs • Rhein-Main / BaWü *
company: Ilias Vassiliou & Team / headhunter.digital / Recruiting für Digital, Sales, IT, KI, Automation
text:
Wenn du bisher mind. 3 Jahre B2B Sales-Erfahrung im Software-Umfeld hast und einen signifikanten nächsten Schritt gehen willst, dann ist das hier ein spannendes Angebot für dich.

Du kannst Beziehungen zu börsennotierten AGs aufbauen, denn alle Unternehmen ab SDAX aufwärts gehören zur Kernzielgruppe (und teils schon bestehenden Nutzerbasis) unseres Mandanten.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du innerhalb des Sales- & Marketing-Teams die Verantwortung für die Neukundenakquise, die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Accounts sowie den Ausbau strategischer Partnerschaften.

Du bist Software Sales Manager und Marktgestalter:in in einem und trägst entscheidend dazu bei, die Nutzung einer führenden Corporate Reporting SaaS-Plattform im DACH-Markt und perspektivisch im europäischen Raum weiter auszubauen.

Diese kollaborative Content- & Design-Plattform wird u.a. genutzt für die Erstellung von Finanzberichten für Investoren und Analysten, z.B. von börsennotierten AGs, oder ESG Reports berichtspflichtiger Unternehmen (u.v.m.).

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team in Frankfurt/Main sowie mit Kolleg:innen in der Schweiz aus Marketing, Produktmanagement, Consulting und Partnernetzwerk zusammen. Gleichzeitig bist du nah an Kunden dran und mit diesen im engen Austausch.

Für wen ist dieser Job?

Dieser Job ist ideal für dich, wenn du mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich B2B Software-Sales / SaaS hast. Relevant ist in dem Kontext, dass du Software-Lösungen sicher & routiniert demonstrieren kannst.

Aufgaben

1) Sales & New Business (ca. 60% unterjährig)

  • Aktive Akquise neuer Kunden in Deutschland, der Schweiz, Österreich und perspektivisch in weiteren europäischen Märkten.

  • Aufbau und Pflege eigener Leadlisten sowie aktive Recherchen in relevanten Branchen & Zielkontakten.

  • Steuerung des gesamten Sales-Cycles: Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Software-Demos, Angebotsentwicklung, Verträge, Übergabe in Delivery.

  • Begleitung neuer Kunden bei Kick-offs, internen Debriefings und frühen Projektphasen – du sorgst für einen perfekten Start.

  • Laufende Betreuung und Ausbau des eigenen Kundenportfolios, inkl. Up- und Cross-Selling (z. B. Plattformwechsel, Add-on-Module, Services).

  • Zusammenarbeit mit zertifizierten Partnern & Agenturen, um Markttrends und Kundenbedürfnisse aus erster Hand zu verstehen.

  • Reporting, Forecasting und Pflege aller Kundendaten.

2) Business Development & Market Shaping (ca. 40% unterjährig)

  • Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen (SaaS, Reporting, Corporate Publishing).

  • Entwicklung neuer Marktstrategien, Segmentfokusse und Wachstumsinitiativen – insbesondere für Deutschland & Nordics.

  • Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten: Standalone-Lösungen, Modulpotenziale, Produktideen aus Marktfeedback.

  • Aufbau von strategischen Partnerschaften (z. B Reseller, Agenturverbünde).

  • Teilnahme an internen Schulungen, Webinaren, Knowledge-Transfer-Sessions.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement – du bringst Kundenstimmen direkt in die Roadmap.

  • Mitwirkung an Events, Messen, Webinaren sowie gemeinsamen Marketingkampagnen.

Qualifikation

Sales-DNA & SaaS-Mindset

  • Aktuelle Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-, Cloud- oder Software-Vertrieb

  • Sicherer Umgang mit B2B Software-Lösungen. u.a. für Kunden-Demos

  • Du magst und machst aktiven Vertrieb und baust Beziehungen auf+

text:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

title: Technical Program Manager, AI Delivery for Public Sector & Defense, Germany
text:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on public sector and defence accounts in Europe, particularly in Germany. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Ministries, Agencies, and defence organisations across Europe. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government and defence engagements.

Location: Germany

Eligibility: This individual must be a German citizen living in Germany and fluent in German, enabling immediate engagement with critical defense and national security customers.

Security Clearance: German security clearance is not required, but is a strong nice-to-have.

What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

  • Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Germany and broader European public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

  • Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

  • Translate complex public sector and defence requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

  • Navigate complex procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

  • Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, pubic sector and defence leadership

  • Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
text:
TL;DR - Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Als Customer Success Manager setzt du neue Standards für moderne Kundenbetreuung und -entwicklung und übernimmst die End-to-End Betreuung unserer Kunden und hilfst dabei, Kunden pro-aktiv zum Erfolg mit unserem Produkt zu führen.

Wieso praxipal?

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Der Austausch findet bei uns ganz selbstverständlich über Teamgrenzen hinweg statt – im Alltag wirst du dabei vor allem mit Julius, Lisa und Daniel eng zusammenarbeiten.

Wonach wir suchen

  • 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, inklusive der Verantwortung für den kompletten Customer Lifecycle (Onboarding bis Renewal)

  • Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Detailgenauigkeit

  • Klare, überzeugende und empathische Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Datengetriebene Denkweise: Über Kennzahlen und Analysen Entscheidungen treffen und Kunden proaktiv steuern

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot) sowie Reporting- und Analyse-Tools

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau

Was du tun wirst

In einem Satz: du begleitest Praxen bei der Einführung unserer KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Nutzung und treibst den kommerziellen Erfolg voran

  • Du führst (Remote-) Onboardings mit Ärzten und Praxisteams durch

  • Du schulst Praxen zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit unserer KI-Rezeptionistin

  • Du dienst als erste Ansprechperson für alle Kundenanliegen

  • Du stehst in engem Austausch mit unseren Kunden und überwachst Produktdaten, um Retention zu gewährleisten und Upselling-Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren

  • Du triagierst Kundenanfragen und gibst technische Anforderungen an unsere Forward Deployed Engineers weiter

Deine Vorteile

  • Kompetitives Gehalt und Beteiligung an unserem VSOP-Programm

title: Growth Associate (Intern)
text:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

 

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

  • Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment

  • Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

  • Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

  • New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

  • Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

  • Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

  • Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

 

Who you are

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

  • Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
text:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

title: Assistant to CMO / Assistenz der Marketingleitung (m/w/d)
text:
Köln | Hybrid | Unbefristete Festanstellung | Bis zu 60.000 € Jahresbrutto

Sie organisieren gern, denken mit und behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn aus einer neuen Idee kurzfristig drei werden? Gleichzeitig arbeiten Sie gerne mit Zahlen und fühlen sich mit Excel und Budgetübersichten wohl?

Für meinen Mandanten, eine etablierte, international tätige Unternehmensgruppe aus dem Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld, suche ich eine kommunikative und strukturierte Persönlichkeit als Assistant to CMO (m/w/d) am Standort Köln.

In der Holding arbeiten Sie eng mit der Marketingleiterin, den Führungskräften des Bereichs und den europäischen Ländergesellschaften zusammen. Sie schaffen Struktur, halten organisatorisch die Fäden zusammen und unterstützen sowohl die CMO als auch das Team im Tagesgeschäft. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Assistenz, Koordination und Budgetthemen.

Ihre Aufgaben im Detail

  • Assistenz mit Überblick: Sie unterstützen die CMO im Tagesgeschäft, koordinieren Termine und Kalender, bearbeiten Korrespondenz und bereiten Unterlagen für Besprechungen vor.

  • Budgets planen und kontrollieren: Sie erstellen Budgetplanungen in Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen, pflegen Übersichten und kontrollieren Ausgaben sowie Budgetentwicklungen. Abweichungen erkennen Sie frühzeitig und sprechen diese an.

  • Zusammenarbeit koordinieren: Sie stimmen sich mit den Teammitgliedern, den Heads und den europäischen Ländergesellschaften ab, holen Informationen ein und behalten offene Aufgaben und Fristen im Blick.

  • Meetings begleiten: Sie organisieren Jour fixes und weitere Besprechungen, führen bei Bedarf Protokoll und halten Ergebnisse sowie vereinbarte nächste Schritte fest.

  • Workshops organisieren: Sie kümmern sich um die organisatorische Vorbereitung und Durchführung – von der Terminabstimmung über Räume und Technik bis zur Betreuung der Teilnehmenden.

  • Reisen organisieren: Sie übernehmen das Travelmanagement für die CMO und den Fachbereich und sorgen für gut abgestimmte Reiseabläufe

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie Berufserfahrung in einer Assistenzfunktion oder einer ähnlichen koordinierenden Tätigkeit.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Budgetplanung und Budgetkontrolle. Sie arbeiten sorgfältig mit Zahlen und haben Freude daran, finanzielle Übersichten aktuell und nachvollziehbar zu halten.

  • Sehr gute Excelkenntnisse: Formeln, Auswertungen und übersichtliche Budgettabellen gehören für Sie zum Arbeitsalltag. Auch mit den weiteren MS-Office-Anwendungen arbeiten Sie sicher.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Sie können sich mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen unkompliziert abstimmen und greifen bei Rückfragen auch zum Telefon.

  • Eine selbstständige, vorausschauende Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, bei wechselnden Prioritäten den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Eine offene, positive Persönlichkeit mit Eigeninitiative, einem verbindlichen Auftreten und einem guten Gespür für unterschiedliche Menschen und Situationen.

  • Freude daran, eine kreative Führungskraft organisatorisch zu unterstützen und zugleich für das Team ansprechbar zu sein.

  • Interesse an Marketingthemen und die Bereitschaft, sich in die Zusammenhänge des Bereichs einzuarbeiten. Vorhandene Marketingkenntnisse sind ein Plus; Ihr fachlicher Schwerpunkt liegt in der Assistenz und Organisation.

  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung direkt bei meinem Mandanten.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Produktentwicklung (all genders)
text:
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen?

Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE, Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill, jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken.

  • Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt.

  • Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein.

  • Rezeptur-Support: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Produktentwicklungen und pflegst Rezepturen und Produktdaten.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
text:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.
  • Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.
  • Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
  • Supporting Engineering Excellence: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

text:
Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen.

Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen?

Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten.

Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Über OIXIO

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

title: BDR Manager
text:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

  • We have strong product market fit. In 2025 we grew ~5x with world class net dollar retention, mostly from founder-led sales, and now have AEs hitting quota with an emerging playbook.

  • We're looking for another BDR Manager to accelerate our outbound engine as we scale in 2026. You'll own a team of ~10 BDRs and be responsible for the pipeline that fuels our growth.

  • You will report to Dave Bentham (Head of Sales) and work closely with our AEs, marketing, and leadership team to make sure the top of funnel is consistently feeding high-quality pipeline.

What You’ll Be Doing

Set the strategy

  • Work with Dave and the rest of leadership to define ICP, targeting, and outbound messaging.

  • Translate company targets into clear, measurable BDR goals and ensure pipeline expectations are distributed strategically across the team.

  • Continuously iterate on outbound plays, channels, and sequences to improve conversion at every stage.

  • Develop the BDR team to be a talent pool for the rest of the organisation through a culture of constant learning

Set your team

  • Manage and develop a team of ~10 BDRs across inbound and outbound.

  • Work alongside our recruiters to grow the team as we scale.

  • Be accountable for team performance. Coach underperformers, promote top performers, and set a high bar across the board.

  • Our BDR team is the talent engine for the entire GTM team. Nurturing the best people and helping them be ready for the next role is crucial.

title: Marketing Lead
text:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Marketing Lead, you turn marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. You report to the Co-Founder and own the marketing plan, budget and team.

Our buyers are GPs, CFOs, COOs and fund operations teams at VC and PE managers. Trust in this market comes from expertise, references and the institutions they already rely on, and almost nobody speaks to the CFO and operations team directly. We will. The founders set the company narrative; you build the engine that carries it to market.

Top priorities

Own marketing’s pipeline contribution

  • Set marketing’s pipeline target by market with the CEO and own the result: qualified pipeline in euros across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Define and run the marketing plan and budget for each market, and decide which programmes to scale and which to stop.

  • Grow our presence beyond our current client base and build our position with larger fund managers.

Build the engine across three vectors

  • Content and credibility: a weekly publishing cadence built on what our fund specialists, founders and clients know (operational deep dives, migration and capital-call guides, case studies with named clients), co-publications and webinars with the institutions and voices our buyers trust, and the data and insights lane: bunch as the source the market and journalists call about European private markets operations. You orchestrate; you run the writer.

  • Field: an events programme you produce in-house for fund CFOs and COOs, who rarely attend the investor events, built as a ladder: a 10-person series per market, seller-owned events, partner events with law firms, auditors and banks, and from there larger flagship formats, eventually a bunch conference.

  • Growth and online: with our Growth Marketing Manager and our sales ops and data team, the digital channels, pooled audiences and the HubSpot attribution and MQL→SQL layer that turn attention into qualified pipeline.

Own positioning and product marketing, with Product

  • Positioning and messaging by tier, release go-to-market, and sales enablement (one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives). Product owns the roadmap and release notes; you own how the market hears about them.

  • Become an expert in our product: sit with client onboarding and the fund specialists until you can demo and explain the platform yourself.

Work hand in hand with sales

  • Run the marketing surround on named target accounts in HubSpot and hand engagement signals on to the sales team, so their next touch lands warm. Sellers own their accounts; marketing never emails a prospect one-to-one.

  • Bring market insight back to the commercial team: what our buyers read, discuss and care about, in a weekly market brief you own.

text:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Music is becoming a first-class part of ElevenLabs Creative. You’ll own the UI that lets creators make it, working closely with Research to turn new music models into products people use the next day.

The open question is what the best interface for AI music creation

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager
text:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Meet the team behind this journey

You will lead the Production Inference team — the group responsible for the systems that serve DeepL's language AI models reliably and efficiently at scale. We sit at the intersection of research-grade technical ambition and production-grade operational discipline: our work determines whether DeepL's models reach users with the latency, reliability, and cost profile that makes commercial deployment viable. The team owns the full model serving stack — from GPU-resident inference runtimes and deployment infrastructure through to the developer platform that enables every other research team to bring their models to production. We operate within the Research organisation, with close ties to DeepL's infrastructure and platform functions, and our architectural decisions affect every product DeepL ships. The broader Research organisation publishes regularly at ACL, NeurIPS, and EMNLP, and the Production Inference team brings that same culture of rigour and innovation to the systems layer of AI.

 

Your responsibilities

As Engineering Manager for the Production Inference team, you will own both people leadership and technical direction for a team of research scientists and ML engineers working on performance-critical model serving systems. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you will be deeply involved in technical reviews, architecture decisions, and research direction for the inference stack.

As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra.

 

What you'll bring

  • Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

Intern qualifications

  • The intern program is open to students graduating December 2027 - June 2028

  • Note: The full benefits listed below are available only to full-time employees. Interns are eligible for a monthly stipend for health insurance, daily lunch, and, of course, free alphorn lessons.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. title: Director of Product Marketing
Alliance & Delivery Manager, Pharma Partnerships
text:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust.

What You'll Do

Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner.

Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development.

Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners.

title: Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.

Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide.

Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation.

Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline.

  • Keep the pieces fitting together. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production.

  • Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope.

  • Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work.

  • Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation.

  • You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships.

  • You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it.

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. About the role:

In 2027, Upvest is launching the PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions) on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers.

About the Role

You'll build work-cell orchestration, instrument drivers, protocol scheduling, error-recovery logic, and monitoring. Physical systems fail in ways pure software doesn't — a plate gets stuck, a liquid handler skips a well, a temperature controller drifts. Your job is to make the system handle all of it gracefully. This is a broad, hands-on role for a strong engineer who wants their code to drive real machines and see it run the same day.

What You'll Do

  • Build orchestration software that coordinates liquid handlers, plate readers, incubators, and robot arms — handling timing dependencies, state, and error recovery.

  • Reverse-engineer and develop instrument drivers and APIs. Each instrument speaks a different protocol (serial, USB, TCP/IP); you work out how it talks and build a clean abstraction over it.

  • Model and execute complex multi-step protocols reliably — a single run can span dozens of steps across multiple instruments.

  • Build error-recovery logic so that when something fails mid-run, the system retries, skips, alerts, or pauses depending on the failure mode.

  • Create monitoring and observability for work-cell health: instrument status, run progress, error rates.

  • Debug across the software–hardware boundary — figuring out whether bad data is a comms, firmware, calibration, or code problem.

  • Work closely with lab automation engineers, the rest of the software team, and the scientists running production.

Stack

TypeScript and Python, Postgres (Supabase), Modal for compute. We control instruments with open-source Python tooling like PyLabRobot and PyHamilton wherever we can, rather than proprietary vendor GUIs.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering skills. You write production code in Python and/or TypeScript — well-structured and maintainable, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable at the hardware-software boundary. You've built software that drives physical devices, or you're excited to. You can read a protocol spec, debug a flaky connection, and reason about timing.

title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization

About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Metering & billing: real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

Mission of this role

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

  • Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

  • Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

  • Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

  • Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

  • Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

  • Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
text:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. title: Stage Mechatronica: EPLAN Fluid
text:
Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in de huidige manier van werken rondom hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s binnen NPD Mechanical Engineering. Op dit moment worden de schema’s opgesteld op een manier die niet-configureerbaar is en beperkte mogelijkheden biedt, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het printen en hergebruiken van coderingen.


Je onderzoekt hoe EPLAN Fluid het beste ingezet kan worden om de huidige aanpak eventueel te vervangen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar “hoe het kan”, maar vooral naar “hoe het moet”. Je werkt hierbij samen met engineers en krijgt de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Je sluit af met een proof of concept: een volledig hydraulisch en pneumatisch machineschema dat als referentie kan dienen voor nieuwe machineontwikkeling.


Mogelijke onderdelen van je opdracht:

  • In kaart brengen van de huidige werkwijze en knelpunten rond hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s;

  • Opstellen van een gestandaardiseerde werkwijze;

  • Verkennen van configuratie- en documentatiemogelijkheden binnen EPLAN Fluid;

  • Bouwen van een proof of concept als referentie;

  • Opleveren van een korte handleiding en overdracht naar de engineers.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

title: Staff Engineer
text:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. With direct CEO reporting, exposure to the VGG ecosystem and strong development opportunities within ISOPLUS, this role offers an attractive step-up for someone looking to move from advising transformation to driving it from within.

ISOPLUS & Viessmann Generations Group

ISOPLUS is a leading European provider of pre-insulated piping systems for district heating and sustainable energy infrastructure, with more than 1,500 team members, nine production sites and a presence across 30+ countries.

Since 2024, ISOPLUS has been part of the Viessmann Generations Group (VGG) portfolio, combining ISOPLUS’ industrial expertise and international footprint with VGG’s long-term ownership perspective and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

The Opportunity

You will build and steer the Group-wide transformation roadmap, creating clear priorities, accountability and transparency across key initiatives. This is not a traditional PMO role. You will combine transformation leadership with hands-on execution, working across Germany, Austria, France, Eastern Europe and other European markets.

Key Challenges & Responsibilities

  • Develop and steer the Group-wide transformation roadmap, translating strategic priorities into clear initiatives, milestones, KPIs and measurable outcomes

  • Drive cross-functional transformation and restructuring initiatives from concept through implementation

  • Establish effective PMO governance and performance tracking, creating transparency on progress, business impact, risks and required decisions

  • Coordinate initiatives across ISOPLUS’ decentralised European organisation, managing dependencies across functions, countries and entities

  • Work closely with initiative owners to remove roadblocks, drive accountability and ensure effective execution

  • Work directly with the CEO and senior leadership, preparing key decisions and providing structured insights on transformation progress and priorities

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in top-tier strategy consulting, with a strong track record in transformation, restructuring or performance improvement

  • Experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives, ideally within industrial, manufacturing or decentralised organisations

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex challenges into clear priorities and actions

  • Hands-on, execution-oriented mindset with high ownership and the ability to drive progress across organisational boundaries

title: Investment Manager - Early Stage Ventures (m/f/d)

Help identify exceptional founders, emerging technologies and investment opportunities that shape the future.

As our Investment Manager – Early Stage Ventures, you'll help identify, evaluate and support investments in startups, venture funds and emerging technologies that shape the future of industries. Beyond identifying new opportunities, you'll work closely with our existing portfolio companies and ecosystem partners to help create long-term strategic value across the Viessmann Generations Group.

From evaluating breakthrough AI companies to supporting industrial portfolio transformation and connecting founders, investors and operating businesses, you'll combine analytical rigor with sound investment judgement to help shape our future portfolio.

Viessmann Generations Group

title: AI Builder — Working Student
text:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
text:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

 

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment
