title: Founding Head Of Talent
text:
Look around you. The office building you're sitting in, the hospital down the street, the data centers powering the AI boom. Every one of them was designed by architects and engineers on software from 1997 and mountains of paperwork.

Because of this, engineers spend 40% of their time not engineering.

That’s time we don’t have. The world faces a massive engineering shortage and in Germany alone there is a backlog of €231 billion in infrastructure, including €69 billion in schools. These are schools not being built because there are simply not enough engineers.

That’s why VOUND exists.

We are building the AI operating layer for the modern planning office. We put the unsexy, non-billable work on autopilot, so architects and engineers can focus on designing.

Why this role matters

The team you build is the company you build. We believe this is the most important role in our company.

What you bring

A relentless instinct for sourcing, and the storytelling to close the best people in the market.

 

What you own

Find exceptional people and bring them on board. You’ll have the freedom and the budget to experiment with anything, from new channels to unconventional ideas no one else has tried.

 

Compensation

We're looking for top-tier talent. For the right person, compensation won't be the limiting factor.

title: Brand Strategy & Social Media @Health Startup
text:
Wir bauen die Marke, auf die unsere Eltern gewartet haben. Bau sie mit uns! ✨

Die meisten Menschen denken bei Muskeln an Fitnessstudio und Bodybuilding. Wir denken an Lebensqualität. Denn Muskeln sind das Fundament eines aktiven Lebens. Sie halten uns beweglich, unabhängig und leistungsfähig im Alltag.

Fortisana ist unsere Antwort darauf: ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink rund um Muskelerhalt und ein aktives Leben. Wir stehen am Anfang – und du kannst mitprägen, wie Menschen uns kennenlernen.

Hinter Fortisana stehen Piran, Leon und Max:

  • Piran hat KoRo mitgegründet und über neun Jahre zu einer der erfolgreichsten Lebensmittelmarken Deutschlands aufgebaut.

  • Leon ist Ernährungsberater und in der Welt der Nahrungsergänzung aufgewachsen. Seine Familie produziert seit über 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel in Deutschland.

  • Max hat bereits mehr als sechs Startups begleitet und zuletzt bei 1KOMMA5° gelernt, wie aus einer Vision ein operativ exzellentes Unternehmen wird.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du übernimmst unseren Markenauftritt auf Social Media. Von der Strategie über die kreative Idee bis zum fertigen Beitrag entwickelst du Inhalte mit einer klaren Handschrift.

  • Du setzt selbst um. Du entwickelst starke Einstiege, planst Drehs, filmst und schneidest Kurzvideos – von Produktaufnahmen über Interviews bis zu Einblicken hinter die Kulissen.

  • Du lernst aus den Ergebnissen. Du veröffentlichst, hörst der Community zu und nutzt ihre Fragen und die Leistungsdaten deiner Beiträge, um die nächsten Ideen besser zu machen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du verstehst Social Media. Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und bei Menschen eine Reaktion auslösen. Dein Portfolio zeigt, was du selbst umgesetzt hast.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür. Für Ästhetik, Sprache, Timing und die Details, die aus einem ordentlichen Video ein richtig gutes machen.

  • Du denkst mit. Sport, Ernährung und Markenaufbau interessieren dich. Du vermittelst Gesundheitsthemen verständlich und sorgfältig, ohne übertriebene Versprechen.

  • Du packst an. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hast Freude daran, sie selbst auf die Straße zu bringen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher. Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du formulierst in beiden Sprachen sicher, präzise und zielgruppengerecht.

  • Du bist vor Ort. Du bist in Berlin oder bereit, für mindestens sechs Monate hierherzukommen.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Videoproduktion, Animation oder Sounddesign.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag. Deine Ideen und deine Arbeit prägen die Marke. Du bekommst Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren und eigene Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Du lernst, wie ein Startup entsteht. Mit direktem Feedback von Gründern, die wissen, wie man starke Verbrauchermarken aufbaut. Achterbahnfahrt inklusive.

  • Du arbeitest mit uns. Wir sind ein kleines Team. Gute Ideen werden gehört, Einsatz wird wertgeschätzt und du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewegt.

  • Du entwickelst dich weiter. Von Markenstrategie und Zielgruppenverständnis über Storytelling bis zu Produktion, Schnitt und KI.

  • Du wächst mit uns. Unsere Ambition ist groß. Wenn wir abheben, fliegst du mit uns.

Lust, dabei zu sein?

Uns interessiert, wie du denkst und was du richtig gut kannst. Ein perfektes Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Zeig uns lieber deine Arbeit. 🤎

title: Staff Digital Media Manager (w/m/d) Programmatic & Social
text:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Du kennst Programmatic in- und auswendig und willst Deinen Kanalbereich nicht nur steuern, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gestaltest Du Programmatic Video, CTV und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte und machst sie mit KI-Workflows schneller und besser.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Du verantwortest Programmatic Video, CTV, Online Video und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte, von der Kanalstrategie über das Setup bis zur laufenden Optimierung.
  • Du entwickelst die Budget- und Kanalplanung für Deine Kanäle inklusive Performance-Forecasts und bringst Deine Empfehlungen in die übergreifende Mediaplanung ein.
  • Du verhandelst und steuerst Deals mit Streaming-Publishern und Vermarktern, z. B. Private Marketplaces, Programmatic Guaranteed und Direct Deals.
  • Du definierst Standards für Tracking, Taxonomie und Testing in Deinen Kanälen, etwa für Brand-Lift- und Creative-Tests, und sorgst dafür, dass alle Märkte sie einhalten.
  • Du baust und betreibst KI-gestützte Workflows für Setup, Reporting und Optimierung, von der ersten Idee bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Qualifikationen

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Media-Management auf Agentur- oder Unternehmensseite mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic Video, CTV oder Online Video.
  • Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung mit DSPs wie DV360 oder The Trade Desk, mit CM360 und Adservern sowie mit Paid Social Video auf Meta, YouTube und TikTok.
  • Tiefes Verständnis von Video-Inventar, Auktionsmechaniken, Deal-Typen und CTV-Besonderheiten wie Frequency Capping und Viewability.
  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Budget- und Kanalplanung über mehrere Märkte inklusive Forecasting und Reporting mit BI-Tools wie Looker oder Tableau.
  • Du hast eigene Automatisierungen mit KI-Tools gebaut, die im Arbeitsalltag laufen, und kannst Beispiele zeigen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, da du Deals mit deutschen Publishern und Vermarktern verhandelst und betreust, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, denn Englisch ist unsere Alltagssprache in der Zusammenarbeit mit Teams über Marken und Märkte hinweg.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
text:
Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

  • Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
  • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
  • Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
  • Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
  • Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring

  • Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
  • Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
  • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
  • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
  • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica

  • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
  • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
  • Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
  • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
  • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
text:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
  • Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
  • Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.
  • Develop product training materials with Product Line Managers and support training for the worldwide Sales network.
  • Maintain product documentation for intranet and corporate purposes.
  • Coordinate annual exhibition and trade show preparation within ESS, based on priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager and Sales, and in alignment with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.
  • Develop marketing concepts, communication campaigns, exhibition experiences, templates and customer engagement initiatives aligned with ESS business priorities.
  • Contribute to the annual ESS strategy review by preparing marketing performance indicators, communication plans and supporting materials.
  • Support the continuous improvement of ESS sales enablement tools and materials, helping ensure that Sales teams have up-to-date product messaging, training and communication.

Requirements

  • Further education in industrial product marketing
  • Degree in marketing, communications, business or a technical field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • Ability to understand electronic products and translate technical information into clear customer-facing content.
  • Solid experience in marketing communications, product marketing or sales enablement in an international industrial B2B environment.
  • Experience creating marketing materials for technical products and collaborating with Sales, Product Management or Engineering teams.

title: Technical Consultant (m/w/d)
text:
Verwandle Visionen zügig in funktionierende Softwarelösungen und revolutioniere die Abbildung von individuellen Geschäftsprozessen – effizient und ohne Programmierung.

title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
text:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
text:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. The central challenge is to harmonize these data sources, quantify uncertainty, and maintain consistency as the map evolves.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and scalable engineering — developing new approaches to geospatial registration, correspondence, and geometric optimization, then productionizing these technologies to directly improve Niantic Spatial's world model.

What You'll Do

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. title: Product Engineer
text:
About the job

About Calibre

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

The institutions and processes we rely on to provide that confidence were built for a slower, more predictable world. AI is advancing faster than the mechanisms we use to trust it.

Calibre is building trust for the AI era as the first AI-native certification body. We develop core technologies to understand AI and cybersecurity risk, and use them to independently assess companies against leading standards.

Founded by two ex-Palantir technical co-founders, and a founding team spanning audit and AI research, we are pushing the frontier of what trust looks like for the AI economy. We’ve raised $3.3M from top tier SF based VCs.

We are hiring a genuinely exceptional Product Engineer to join the founding team and build a new class of products to supercharge our AI-native certification process.

The other half is reliability engineering: making those systems observable, resilient, and cheap to operate. If you’ve ever shipped a service and then wished you owned how it ran in production, this is that job.

We’ve kept the split explicit rather than tidy. Our Platform Engineering team owns the shared platform, tooling and automation; you’ll be a close partner to them, and the reliability of your own services is yours.

We’re looking for people who thrive in an empowered environment - engineers who are comfortable being given problems to solve rather than solutions to implement. You should enjoy working at pace, value autonomy, and prefer to ask for forgiveness rather than permission.

Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Backend engineering

  • Design, build and maintain the backend services behind our real-time and analytical data processing.

  • Optimise pipelines and services for low latency, high throughput and scale.

  • Own features end to end, from shaping the approach to running them in production.

  • Contribute to design reviews with a clear view on the trade-offs

text:

title: Talent Partner (EU/UK Based - Remote)
text:
About the role

Duvo helps large enterprises map, optimise and execute the long-running, messy operational work that runs across their systems: ERPs, portals, email, spreadsheets, calls. We sell into Heads of Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and IT at large retailers and FMCG brands. New deals land at €100k–€250k ARR and grow materially through expansion.

We're about to grow fast across engineering and go-to-market, and into new European markets, without lowering the bar. Agencies alone can't get us there. We're hiring a Talent Partner who goes out and finds the people themselves, owns a set of roles and EU markets end to end, and works with our hiring managers as a partner, not a scheduling desk.

You'll report to Marko, who leads talent at Duvo, and work directly with our founders and hiring managers.

What you'll do

Own your roles and markets. You'll take a portfolio of roles across engineering and GTM, plus the European markets we're pushing hardest into. Open the role, build the pipeline, run the process, close the offer. You're accountable for the hire landing, not for the funnel looking busy.

Source directly. Most of the people we want will never apply. You'll run outbound on LinkedIn and beyond, work referrals properly, and use AI to find candidates nobody else is talking to. When a role opens, you've got people on the phone that week.

Own the screen. Every candidate who reaches a hiring manager has been through you first. Strong screening calls, clear written notes, an honest pass or fail. You'd rather reject a maybe than waste a loop.

Partner with hiring managers. Agree the bar before the first CV, calibrate in writing, chase feedback until it lands, and push back when a process or a requirement doesn't make sense.

Keep the agencies honest. For your markets, brief agency partners properly, hold them to our bar, and cut the ones that send noise.

Run a tight, automated process. Scheduling, trial days, logistics, candidate comms. Nothing falls through the cracks, and anything you do twice gets automated. We build AI agents for a living and we run hiring the same way: Ashby underneath, AI across screening, research and interview prep, and agents handling scheduling and chasing. You'll use that system every day and help build the next parts of it.

Look after candidates. Everyone who talks to us knows where they stand, quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.


Who you are

  • 3+ years in recruiting, in-house at a startup or scale-up or at a tech-focused agency, with full-cycle ownership.

  • A real sourcer. You can show us pipelines you built from zero for hard roles, not just inbound you processed.

  • Experience hiring engineers, plus comfort with commercial roles like AEs, partner managers or consultants.

  • Experience hiring across European markets.

  • Technically literate. You can read a GitHub profile, understand a stack and hold a credible first conversation with an engineer. You don't need to code, but you can't be bluffing in that call.

  • A bar-raiser. You'll make the pass or fail call and stand behind it.

  • Organised to a fault. A clean pipeline and an empty to-do list matter to you.

  • You say it straight, to candidates, to hiring managers and to us.

title: Junior Transformation Strategist (UK Based)
text:
About Duvo

Before Duvo, our founders built and ran a $2 billion retailer. They saw how much critical work still depended on spreadsheets, inboxes, supplier portals and the memory of experienced operators. The real process rarely lived in one system. People held the last mile together.

Duvo is building the Enterprise Execution OS: the shared layer that understands how work really runs, carries it across existing systems and measures the business result.

Our agents do the work, not just suggest the next step. They gather evidence, make decisions within agreed rules, route exceptions to the right person and update the source system. People keep control wherever judgment or approval is needed. Every action leaves an audit trail.

We start with one recurring process and a clear outcome. Every solution carries a contracted 5x ROI guarantee.

The role

As a Junior Transformation Strategist, you are the insight and output engine beside our Transformation Strategists on our largest accounts.

On bigger engagements we need more than technical delivery. We need someone who can take a messy process, find the critical question, get to a clear insight fast, and put it into materials a customer team will act on. Today that work often lands on Forward Deployed Engineers. That is the wrong use of a scarce technical resource. This role exists so that insight work has a dedicated owner.

You will work alongside Transformation Strategists (who own day-to-day account presence and workstream direction) and Forward Deployed Engineers (who own the technical solution). You do not own the executive relationship or the commercial outcome. You own the speed and quality of the analytical and written work that makes those conversations possible.

This is a fungible problem-solving role. You will be thrown at different accounts and different problem types (category, supply chain, finance ops, inventory, commercial) and expected to produce. Ideal for someone currently ~2–4 years into a client-facing career as an Associate, Senior Associate, or Consultant at McKinsey or BCG who wants concentrated ownership, not another staffing cycle.

We want to hire two people into this role quickly.

What you will do

1. Get to the insight

  • Dive into how work actually happens: interviews, extracts, handoffs, exceptions and the workarounds people use to keep things running.

  • Build a fact base that shows where cost, cash, service, cycle time or control is being lost.

  • Form a hypothesis early, name what would kill it, and pressure-test it with the Transformation Strategist before you polish anything.

  • Structure unfamiliar problems without waiting for a perfect brief. Frame the selection equation (what matters, what does not) so the team and the customer can decide.

2. Deliver output that moves a decision

  • Turn analysis into decision-ready slides, one-pagers and memos that make the important choice obvious.

  • Be exact about baselines, assumptions and evidence. Do not use polish to hide uncertainty.

  • Work fast: same-day or next-day turnarounds on defined asks are the norm, not the exception.

  • Produce materials a Transformation Strategist can take into a working session or steerco with minimal rewrite.

3. Be fungible surge capacity on big accounts

title: Full Stack Engineer
text:
Full Stack Engineer


London, 4x days per week in-office


Vega is looking for a Full Stack Developer to build features end to end across our platform from Java/Spring Boot services and APIs to React and TypeScript interfaces – using AI tools as a core part of how they work and helping bring AI-powered capabilities into the product.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry's first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done – from the start of an investor's journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it's also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world's leading technology and financial services firms – including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won't be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.



Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

  • Own problems from scoping through shipping and iteration, working directly with business and engineering teams to turn ideas into production features across the full stack

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Co

title: Mechatronics Engineer
text:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The role

Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine:

  • Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification

  • Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism

  • Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations

  • Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop

  • Bring it to life with software on our in-house robotics operating system

We work AI-first. AI tools help you scope the problem, drive your CAD, run the calculations and write the machine software. The software side needs basic software engineering skills, not a software background: you'll write it with AI agents, supported by a dedicated software engineering team who build the operating system.

You must have built things before, ideally robots, whether as a hobbyist, student, employee or founder. We don't hire narrow specialists. We want engineers who can:

  • Diagnose system-wide failures from first principles

  • Prototype mechanical and software fixes on the fly

  • Work autonomously and communicate clearly with a team spread across sites

  • Take responsibility for how their machines perform in live production

Things you'll do

This is a design role with hands-on prototyping. For example:

  • Conceive new mechanisms to handle electronics parts and other robotic handling tasks, using AI to scope and specify the problem

  • Design gantries and end effectors in Fusion 360

  • Use AI agents to run the engineering calculations, and know when to distrust them

  • Machine prototype parts in our in-house CNC shop

  • Analyse end-effector behaviour from video and revise its geometry and control approach to improve throughput and reliability

  • Program machine behaviour on our in-house robotics operating system, with AI agents doing the heavy lifting

  • Specify sensors that catch errors while a machine is running, or monitor a chemical process

  • Prototype and deploy a new test robot for in-line PCB validation

  • Commission your machines and hand them over to our build team to scale up

  • Work across our US and UK sites to share what you've learned and shape the roadmap

Électricité – Courants forts et faibles

title: Strategic Account Manager - Enterprise Hospitality (Paris)
text:
Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level.

***Please note that this role is based in Paris and follows a hybrid working model***



What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
text:
Résumé

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

Notre culture

Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi

Nous gérons l'une des marketplaces tripartites les plus complexes du monde et nous le faisons en temps réel. text:
CHAMP D'APPLICATION DU POSTE

Le/La agent(e) du service client (Guest Service Officer), doit assurer un service de première ligne irréprochable en prenant en charge l’enregistrement des clients ainsi que la gestion des accès aux lounges avec précision, professionnalisme et efficacité. Le/La collaborateur-rice contribue activement au bon fonctionnement de l’espace en accompagnant les clients, en assurant les contrôles de zone, en gérant les flux et les files d’attente, tout en identifiant et en escaladant rapidement les problématiques liées au service ou à la maintenance.

Il/elle participe également au développement du chiffre d’affaires en promouvant et en vendant les offres lounges, les campagnes ponctuelles, les partenariats ainsi que les adhésions au programme Smart Traveller. Enfin, il/elle veille au respect des standards opérationnels en appliquant rigoureusement les procédures internes (SOP), en garantissant l’exactitude des transactions, en optimisant l’utilisation des ressources et en assurant un haut niveau d’hygiène ainsi que la confidentialité des clients.

RESPONSABILITÉS DU POSTE

  • Gérer efficacement le processus d'enregistrement des invités, en garantissant l'exactitude des droits des invités, le respect des consignes d'admission et la transmission d'une première impression bienvenue.
  • Accueillir, recevoir et remercier les invités à la réception avec professionnalisme, courtoisie et excellence du service.
  • Assister les clients lors de leurs demandes.
  • Adresser rapidement les demandes des clients, en faisant remonter les questions complexes ou les préoccupations de service au responsable du lounge, si nécessaire.
  • Effectuer des contrôles de routine dans les espaces de détente — tels que les zones de salon, buffet, aires de repos, et signaler immédiatement les problèmes d'entretien ou de propreté.
  • Promouvoir activement les services proposés pour soutenir les objectifs de génération de revenus.
  • Encourager et inscrire les clients au programme Smart Traveller (ST) en expliquant les avantages et en veillant à une bonne compréhension des informations lors de l'inscription.
  • Suivre les procédures d'objets perdus en documentant avec précision les objets, en assurant une manipulation sécurisée et en informant le superviseur.
  • Répondre de manière professionnelle aux appels téléphoniques, aux e-mails et aux communications internes, en veillant à une assistance rapide et à des informations claires.
  • Gérer les transactions de points de vente, les reçus, les bons et les paiements sans espèces avec précision et conformément aux directives financières et aux procédures opérationnelles standard.
  • Aider aux efforts de contrôle des coûts en utilisant de manière responsable la papeterie, les formulaires et les matériaux opérationnels et en signalant les gaspillages inutiles.
  • Maintenir la confidentialité des informations des clients en permanence.
  • Soutenir la préparation opérationnelle en aidant à la gestion des files d'attente, à l'affluence des foules, aux procédures d'ouverture/fermeture.
  • Collaborer avec le responsable de service/lounge pour maintenir un flux de service fluide et respecter les normes internes PPG.
  • Participer à des réunions d'équipe, des sessions de formation et des audits qualité afin d'améliorer la prestation des services et les connaissances opérationnelles.
  • Effectuer toutes les tâches supplémentaires assignées par le superviseur ou le responsable des opérations.

Cette liste est non exhaustive

  • Une première expérience en hôtellerie, restauration
  • Bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication
  • Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais et du français
  • Une autre langue parlée serait un plus

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines - 60%

text:
À propos de FPP Industries

FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines.

Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines à 60 %, directement rattaché à la Direction générale.

L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise.

Pourquoi ce poste existe

Jusqu’à présent, les différents sujets RH ont été pris en charge sans fonction RH dédiée.

Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié.

Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste.

Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer.

Votre mission

Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries, en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement.

Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes.

Vos responsabilités principales

Garantir une administration RH et une paie fiables.
Vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif des collaborateurs, de leur arrivée à leur départ : contrats et avenants, absences, congés, périodes d’essai, visites médicales, échéances et dossiers individuels. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais.

Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations.
Vous accompagnez les managers dans la définition de leurs besoins, rédigez et diffusez les offres, présélectionnez les candidatures, réalisez les premiers entretiens et coordonnez le processus jusqu’à l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.

Développer les compétences.
Vous identifiez les besoins avec les managers, organisez et suivez les formations et contribuez progressivement à construire une vision claire des compétences disponibles et à développer dans l’entreprise.

Accompagner les managers et les collaborateurs.
Vous devenez un interlocuteur RH accessible au quotidien. Vous accompagnez les managers dans leurs problématiques humaines, organisez les campagnes d’entretiens et contribuez à identifier suffisamment tôt les situations nécessitant une attention particulière.

Structurer et améliorer les pratiques RH.
Vous fiabilisez les données, construisez les indicateurs utiles au pilotage, formalisez les processus et proposez des améliorations concrètes pour simplifier le fonctionnement RH et l’expérience collaborateur.

Accompagner la mise en conformité liée au développement de l’entreprise.
Vous contribuerez notamment aux chantiers liés au CSE, au DUERP et à la structuration progressive de la démarche RSE, en lien avec la Direction et l’évolution de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous attendons de vous

Indispensable

Vous disposez de bases solides en administration du personnel et droit social français.

Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge la production des bulletins de salaire, tout en sachant solliciter un prestataire ou un conseil externe lorsqu’une situation nécessite une expertise technique ou réglemen

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. title: Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
text:
Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé.

Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil…
Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain.

Votre mission
L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs.
Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de :

  • Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents.
  • Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non).
  • Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes.
  • Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés.

Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale.
Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage.

Requirements

  • Connaissances théoriques en traitement du signal et en machine learning
  • Compétences informatiques : programmation en Python, première expérience en framework deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) appréciée
  • Bonus : programmation en C
  • Intérêt pour le machine learning
  • Intérêt pour les applications en santé connectée
  • Lecture de l'anglais scientifique et technique
  • Capacité rédactionnelle, de rigueur et d'autonomie
  • Aptitude pour le travail en équipe et communication
  • Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Assister à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médic

title: AI-Native Software Engineering Lead / Agentic Development Expert
text:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on AI-Native Software Engineering Lead to drive the transformation of software development practices within a complex enterprise banking environment.

The objective is to fundamentally modernize the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by introducing AI-powered coding agents, autonomous engineering workflows, and AI-first development methodologies.

This role is not focused on building traditional AI applications or chatbots. Instead, you will work directly with engineering teams to demonstrate how AI agents can automate substantial parts of the software development process, from requirements analysis to implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-native software engineering practices within established enterprise development teams.

  • Design, implement, and optimize agentic development workflows using AI coding agents and LLM-powered automation.

  • Automate engineering activities, including requirements analysis, codebase exploration, solution design, code generation, testing, code reviews, and deployment preparation.

  • Integrate AI-powered development tools, particularly GitHub Copilot and autonomous coding agents, into existing engineering environments.

  • Transform traditional SDLC processes into AI-first workflows with clearly defined human oversight and quality gates.

  • Develop practical proofs of concept and implement AI-driven automation within existing enterprise applications and complex codebases.

  • Establish governance mechanisms covering AI-generated code, validation, traceability, approval workflows, and accountability.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, DevOps specialists, and platform teams.

  • Mentor and coach development teams in adopting AI-assisted and increasingly autonomous engineering practices.

  • Conduct technical workshops, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing sessions to accelerate AI adoption.

  • Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including designing, developing, testing, and maintaining enterprise applications.

  • Proven hands-on experience with AI-powered software development tools and coding agents, preferably GitHub Copilot.

  • Practical experience with LLMs, Generative AI, tool/function calling, RAG, structured extraction, and agentic workflows.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI-powered automation or agentic workflows within existing large-scale software projects, rather than exclusively standalone prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of the complete SDLC and PDLC, including requirements engineering, software architecture, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Experience working with complex enterprise codebases, established architectures, and mature engineering processes.

  • Solid knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering automation.

  • Ability to independently develop proofs of concept and translate experimental approaches into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience mentoring software engineers and introducing new development tools, practices, and methodologies.

  • Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.

  • A pragmatic, hands-on mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in dynamic environments.

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
text:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
  • Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
  • Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.
  • Develop product training materials with Product Line Managers and support training for the worldwide Sales network.
  • Maintain product documentation for intranet and corporate purposes.
  • Coordinate annual exhibition and trade show preparation within ESS, based on priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager and Sales, and in alignment with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.
  • Develop marketing concepts, communication campaigns, exhibition experiences, templates and customer engagement initiatives aligned with ESS business priorities.
  • Contribute to the annual ESS strategy review by preparing marketing performance indicators, communication plans and supporting materials.
  • Support the continuous improvement of ESS sales enablement tools and materials, helping ensure that Sales teams have up-to-date product messaging, training and communication.

Requirements

  • Further education in industrial product marketing
  • Degree in marketing, communications, business or a technical field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • Ability to understand electronic products and translate technical information into clear customer-facing content.
  • Solid experience in marketing communications, product marketing or sales enablement in an international industrial B2B environment.
  • Experience creating marketing materials for technical products and collaborating with Sales, Product Management or Engineering teams.

title: Afstuderen Artificial Intelligence: Ontwikkel de AI-generator voor Account Business Reviews
text:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Account Business Reviews (ABR’s) vormen de rode draad in de gesprekken tussen onze accountmanagers en klanten. Tijdens deze periodieke meetings staan de samenwerking, prestaties, aandachtspunten, kansen en gezamenlijke vervolgstappen centraal. De voorbereiding kost nu veel tijd, omdat relevante informatie uit verschillende systemen en bronnen handmatig moet worden verzameld en samengevoegd.

Jouw uitdaging is om te onderzoeken hoe informatie uit verschillende systemen binnen een veilige en gecontroleerde omgeving automatisch kan worden samengebracht en verwerkt tot een professioneel ABR-rapport. AI helpt bij het structureren, samenvatten en formuleren van relevante inzichten, aanbevelingen en onderwerpen voor het komende gesprek. Zo help je accountmanagers om beter voorbereid en met meer focus aan tafel te zitten.

Ook na de meeting speelt AI een belangrijke rol. Je onderzoekt hoe gesprekken efficiënt kunnen worden samengevat, hoe besluiten en actiepunten worden vastgelegd en hoe de gemaakte afspraken terugkomen in het rapport of in een bevestiging aan de klant. De uiteindelijke oplossing staat niet vooraf vast. Jij bepaalt op basis van gebruikersbehoeften, beschikbare data, AI-mogelijkheden en technische haalbaarheid welke aanpak het beste bij Voortman past.

BEOOGD RESULTAAT

Het beoogde resultaat is een onderbouwd advies met een gevalideerd AI-concept of prototype voor het ABR-proces. De oplossing ondersteunt de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van klantgesprekken en laat zien hoe informatie uit verschillende bronnen kan worden omgezet in een bruikbaar rapport, concrete afspraken en heldere klantcommunicatie. De aanpak moet praktisch toepasbaar, betrouwbaar en schaalbaar zijn binnen Voortman.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
text:
Wat ga je doen?

Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen.

 

Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn.

 

Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s.

Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders.

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
text:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

At Qualinx, we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology- you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Responsibilities: 

As a Sr. Silicon Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and executing test plans to ensure the functionality and performance of SOC integrating Digital, Analog and RF components. This role requires hands-on experience in debugging, analyzing, and characterizing SoCs through automated test setups.

Key responsibilities will include: 

  • Collaborating closely with the design teams, firmware, and software teams to define digital test requirements and validation plans. 

  • Developing and executing comprehensive test plans to validate all digital functionalities. 

  • Working on SoC-level validation and bring-up, managing tests from component-level through to full system operation. 

  • Creating Python/C scripts to automate tests and collect measurements using automated setups with digital test equipment. 

  • Collecting, organizing, and analyzing data to verify performance across various conditions for different samples. 

  • Utilizing tools like Python for scripting and data handling to automate processes and enhance analysis. 

  • Debugging and troubleshooting issues that arise during testing, including hardware, firmware, and digital interface issues, and collaborating with design, applications, and software teams to implement solutions. 

  • Documenting test procedures, validation results, and specifications for internal reference and compliance.
