title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
text:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Gehalt

5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren

Benefits

  • 100 % remote

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst

  • Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben)

  • Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live

  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst

title: Senior Events Growth Manager
text:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon and AgenticCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together thousands of platform engineers, platform leaders every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Events Growth Marketing Manager to own registration and attendance growth across our entire events portfolio. That starts with our flagship conferences, PlatformCon and AgenticCon, the biggest conferences in the platform engineering world, which travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, and extends to our roadshows, roundtables, workshops, House of Kube (the largest party in the cloud native world) and the satellite events we run in cities around major conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Your goal is to bring platform engineering leaders into the room and keep them coming back. This is a systems and relationships role, not a one off campaign role. You’ll build the growth loops, the audience, and the repeatable playbook needed to fill these events and drive high attendance every time. You’ll report to the Head of Growth.

What you'll do

  • Own registration and attendance growth for PlatformCon and AgenticCon ticket sales, and for every other event we run, across San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam.

  • Build growth loops and long term relationships with the platform engineering community, its practitioners and its leaders, so we have an audience to pull from in every city.

  • Own our event pages on Luma and the end to end campaigns that fill them.

  • Plan campaigns designed for a high attendance rate, so the right people do not just register but actually show up.

  • Use HubSpot and Luma to build and target the right audience segments for each event.

  • Collaborate with design team to ensure high quality event pages and with content for strong copy and assets.

  • Brief and work with our performance marketing and lifecycle managers to get paid and email support behind each event.

  • Build the systems and the playbook that let us fill these events repeatedly, so the approach compounds instead of starting from scratch each time.

What success looks like

Within your first 90 days, we want you to come back to us with a proposed playbook: how we should run our in person events, and the exact workflow you would follow every time a new event brief lands, from audience to event page to campaigns to attendance. By 180 days, we want that playbook proven on live events, with a rising attendance rate and a reusable audience building in each city.

What you'll bring

  • A systems thinker who works in growth loops, not one off tactics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing. Even better if you have worked somewhere whose core business is running events.

  • A track record of building and growing audiences and driving real attendance at in person events, not just registrations.

  • Strong hands on experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot for segmentat

title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition
text:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

The role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. title: Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
text:
We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)

You'll own iwoca's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

  • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trust

title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft
text:
PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen.

Aufgaben

  • Zertifizierung als Entsorgungsfachbetrieb verantworten: Umfang festlegen (Tätigkeiten, Standorte, Abfallarten), Prüfstelle auswählen, Überwachungsvertrag abschließen, Erst- und Jahresprüfungen begleiten

  • Betriebsorganisation nach EfbV aufbauen und pflegen: Organisationsplan, Arbeitsanweisungen, Betriebstagebuch, Versicherungs-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Fachkundenachweise

  • Alle behördlichen Formalitäten erledigen: Anzeigen und Erlaubnisse nach KrWG, Anträge, Fragenkataloge und Fristen

  • Geschäftsführung, Operations, Technik und Vertrieb in Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen beraten, von der AVV-Einstufung bis zur Wahl der Entsorgungsroute

  • Abfallströme aus unseren mobilen Einsätzen, Labor und Technikum einstufen, Analytik veranlassen und Entsorgungspartner qualifizieren

  • Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

  • Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

  • Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet

  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Abfallwirtschaft, idealerweise mit gefährlichen oder flüssigen Abfällen

  • Fachkunde nach § 9 EfbV mit anerkanntem Fachkundelehrgang

  • Zuverlässigkeit im Sinne von § 8 EfbV, nachgewiesen durch Führungszeugnis und Gewerbezentralregisterauszug

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in KrWG, EfbV, NachwV und AVV sowie Praxis mit dem eANV

  • Erfahrung mit Zertifizierungsaudits und souveräner Umgang mit Behörden und Sachverständigen

  • Strukturierte, gründliche Arbeitsweise mit sicherem Gespür für Fristen und Dokumentation

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, auch im Behördenschriftverkehr; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team

  • Führerschein Klasse B für Einsätze bei Kunden

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung mit PFAS, Feuerlöschschäumen oder POP-haltigen Abfällen

  • Qualifikation als Abfallbeauftragte/r oder Gefahrgutbeauftragte/r

  • Kenntnisse in AwSV, BImSchG und ADR

  • Erfahrung mit ISO 14001 oder ISO 9001

Benefits

  • Echte Wirkung: Du hilfst mit, eine der großen globalen Umweltherausforderungen zu lösen

  • Verantwortung: Du baust den Entsorgungsfachbetrieb PFASuiki von Grund auf mit auf und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle Entsorgungsfragen

  • Breites Aufgabenfeld: Abfallrecht, Zertifizierung, Behördenarbeit, Einsätze bei Kunden und die Markteinführung einer neuen Zerstörungstechnologie

  • Startup-Kultur: Ein dynamisches, kollegiales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen unsere Technologie und Strategie direkt prägen

  • Weiterbildung: Fachkunde- und Fortbildungslehrgänge sind bei uns fest eingeplant

  • Attraktives Paket: Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung

  • Weitere Benefits wie Zuschüsse zu ÖPNV und Mittagess

title: Interesse an admkrs? (m/w/d)
text:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Wir schreiben hier keine Stelle aus. Diese Seite ist für Leute, die admkrs kennen, unsere Arbeit verfolgen und einen konkreten Grund haben, warum sie genau hier hingehören. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft, lies weiter. Wenn du gerade an zwanzig Agenturen dieselbe Bewerbung schickst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Ort.

Du sagst uns, welche Lücke du bei uns schließt. Nicht wir dir. Wir sind rund 20 Leute in München, arbeiten für Marken wie ESN, arena und asambeauty an Performance-Kampagnen, Creatives, Video und eigener Technologie. Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur.
  • Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung.
  • Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben.
  • Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein.

Warum wir?

  • Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen.
  • Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter.
  • Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst.
  • Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München.

Darauf schauen wir

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit.

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern.

title: Langfuse - Senior Software Engineer, SDK
text:
Why SDK Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Owning our SDKs. We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation.

  • Designing APIs that developers love. How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. When we shipped the Python SDK v3 and TypeScript SDK v4, both were full rewrites on OpenTelemetry — that's the kind of thoughtful, high-impact SDK work you'll lead. Apart from tracing, we also support core workflows of engineers building with LLMs with our SDKs, see our Experiment Runner SDK for example.

  • Integrating with every major AI framework: Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You'll maintain these integrations, ensure new Langfuse features are supported across all of them, and add new integrations as the ecosystem evolves. When a new framework gains traction, you'll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Maintaining our OpenTelemetry endpoint: some users send traces directly to our OTLP endpoint instead of using our SDKs. You'll ensure this path is robust, well-documented, and supports the full range of Langfuse features. This also extends our language support to Java, Go, and any language with an OpenTelemetry SDK. You can work with the OpenTelemetry community to steer the GenAI conventions.

title: Head of FinOps
text:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

The role

Every payment that goes through Ryft creates a trail of money moving between card schemes, acquiring banks, our accounts and our merchants. You make sure that trail adds up, every day, and that customer funds are protected exactly as the FCA requires.

You'll own Ryft's financial operations end to end: reconciliations, settlement, safeguarding and the reporting that proves it. It's a hands-on role. You'll run the daily processes yourself, then automate them, so they scale as we launch in new markets and currencies.

What you'll do

• Reconciliations: run daily reconciliations across scheme and acquirer settlement reports, bank statements and our internal ledger. Investigate and resolve breaks quickly and accurately.

• Safeguarding: own the daily internal and external safeguarding reconciliations under CASS 15, prepare the monthly safeguarding return, keep the resolution pack current and support the annual safeguarding audit.

• Settlement and payouts: make sure merchants are paid the right amount on time, across currencies, and that split payments and escrow balances tie out.

• Fees and cost of payments: reconcile interchange, scheme and acquirer fees against what we've billed, and flag where margin is leaking.

• Disputes and chargebacks: track the financial side of chargebacks, refunds and reserves.

• Month-end: feed accurate payment data into the close and work with Finance on revenue and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Automation: work with Engineering and Product to replace spreadsheets with automated recs, alerts and dashboards.

• Controls and documentation: write and maintain the SOPs, controls and evidence that auditors and the FCA will ask for.,

• Expansion: help design the finance operations for new payment flows, entities and licences, starting with our EU licence application in Malta.

What we're looking for

• 4+ years in financial operations, payment operations, treasury or reconciliations at a payments company, EMI, acquirer or fintech.

• Hands-on experience of daily reconciliations at volume with the highest level of attention to detail. You know how to investigate and resolve the root cause of a break, not just clear it.

• Working knowledge of UK safeguarding rules (PSRs 2017, EMRs 2011, CASS 15) and what an auditor expects to see.

title: Software Engineer, Product
text:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

You'll work across LabOS — our internal software platform — building the orchestration layer that coordinates everything from experiment scheduling to execution to data capture and results processing. This is full-stack product engineering at the intersection of software and physical-world biology.

Day-to-day, that can mean things like:

  • Creating interfaces and APIs that give scientists and AI agents visibility into what's happening in the lab in real time

  • Building custom AI agents and tooling that automate decisions across the experiment lifecycle, from protocol design to troubleshooting failed results

  • Turning proprietary hardware into API-controllable devices that agents and software can operate programmatically

  • Designing scheduling systems that coordinate dozens of lab instruments with complex dependency chains

You'll own large areas of the product. We're a small team where individual engineers have large impact on what gets built and how.

What we're looking for

  • Full-stack production experience. We use TypeScript, React, Node, Postgres, but what matters is you can work across the stack.

  • Product instinct. You've shipped, watched users, iterated, and shipped again.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity. You start from a goal, not a spec. You scope problems down, decide what to build and what to skip, and write your own plan when none exists.

  • Builds with AI. You use AI tools heavily, but you have enough experience without them to know what good looks like.

  • Curious about biology. No background required, but running real experiments in the physical world should excite you.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Platform Engineer
text:
About Augur

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

The Role

As a Platform Engineer at Augur, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, and scalability of our critical systems. You will bridge the gap between software development and IT operations by applying a software engineering mindset to system administration.

● System Architecture and Design: Design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that runs our platforms. Develop scalable, secure and highly reliable systems to support our services.
● Automation and Tooling: Automate manual operational tasks, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Develop and maintain tools to improve efficiency and reduce the potential for human error.
● Software Development: Write and review code (Ansible, Terraform, Python) for infrastructure automation, monitoring tools, and system improvements. Contribute to the development lifecycle to ensure reliability is built into our products from the start.
● Performance and Reliability: Proactively monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and low latency. Fill in the gaps in monitoring systems when observed.
● Incident Management: Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents. Lead incident response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
● Capacity Planning: Analyse system usage, cost and performance data to make informed decisions about resource allocation. Forecast future infrastructure needs and scale our systems accordingly.
● Collaboration and Best Practices: Work closely with software development teams to promote reliability best practices. Champion a culture of reliability across the engineering organisation.
● Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all systems, processes, and operational procedures as a core part of everyday work. Treat documentation as a first-class engineering deliverable.

Accessibility and inclusivity

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.

title: Internal Communications Lead
text:
Internal Communications Lead

Elliptic has been tracking down crypto crime since 2013, trusted by banks, businesses, and governments worldwide to keep the financial system safe. Today, our compliance tools cover the large majority of global crypto exchange volume, and a $120m Series D is fueling the next stage of that work.

title: Lead Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
text:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you'll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You'll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to lead the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Own the technology roadmap and device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Lead mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Manage fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: define process flows, review process and in-line data, and resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Define and lead the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and drive design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Mentor engineers and, as the team grows, help recruit and develop new team members

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 6+ years' relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 8+ years' relevant experience, including at least 4 years' hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Proven track record of taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including qualification

  • Deep understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Proven ability to lead technical projects across design, process, test and packaging functions, and experience mentoring or supervising engineers

title: Engineering Lead
text:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

text:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Meta & Google (H/F)
text:
À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

Le poste

L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux.

En tant que Senior Performance Marketing Manager, vous êtes responsable de la performance de ces comptes. Le succès, c'est un CAC maîtrisé, un délai de retour sur investissement qui respecte nos objectifs, et une capacité à identifier vite ce qu'il faut arrêter et ce qu'il faut amplifier.

Vos missions

  • Vous pilotez et faites monter en puissance les comptes Meta et Google de Scento (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Advantage+) sur les marchés européens.
  • Vous gérez budgets, enchères, structure de compte et tests, au regard d'objectifs de CAC et de délai de retour.
  • Vous briefez et testez les créations avec l'équipe marque, lisez la donnée créative et décidez vite d'arrêter ou d'amplifier.
  • Vous veillez à la santé du tracking avec l'analytics et la data (Conversions API, conversions avancées, GA4).
  • Vous ouvrez de nouveaux marchés et de nouveaux canaux, comme TikTok et Microsoft Ads, quand les chiffres le justifient.

Votre profil

  • Plus de 6 ans d'acquisition payante en e-commerce, avec de gros budgets mensuels.
  • Une expertise approfondie de Meta Ads et de Google Ads, et de solides compétences en tableurs et en analytics.
  • Une expérience sur plusieurs pays européens.
  • Un anglais courant ; le français ou l'allemand est un plus.

Une expérience préalable dans la vente de logiciels ou l'immobilier est appréciée, mais n'est pas indispensable.

Nous nous intéressons avant tout à votre motivation, à votre capacité à comprendre les besoins des clients et à votre envie de participer au développement d'un projet technologique.

Bereits 2016 und 2018 brillierte die CONCORDIA beim Swiss Arbeitgeber Award mit hervorragenden Ergebnissen. Im Jahr 2020 holten wir uns dann sogar den ersten Platz in der Kategorie für grosse Unternehmen mit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeitenden und im Jahr 2022 wurden wir mit dem zweiten Platz ausgezeichnet. Auch im Jahr 2025 dürfen wir mit gutem Recht festhalten, dass wir zu den allerbesten Arbeitgeberinnen der Schweiz gehören.

Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %

Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen Betrieb, das Engineering und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Oracle- und PostgreSQL-Datenbankplattform sowohl im Daily Business als auch in Projekten und Releases.
  • Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbank- und Data-Warehouse-Plattformen, bei der Migration von Oracle nach PostgreSQL und beim Ausbau unserer Datenbankplattformen in der Azure Cloud.
  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Automatisierung, Performance-Analyse, Scripting, Monitoring und Logging.
  • Infrastructure as Code ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise: Du entwickelst unsere Automatisierung und Infrastruktur-Standards aktiv weiter. Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.

  • Austausch und Weiterentwicklung sind uns wichtig: Du hast regelmässig die Möglichkeit, User Groups und Hersteller-Events zu besuchen.
  • Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen.
  • Wir sprechen CH-Mundart & Deutsch und sind mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Büro Luzern.
  • Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
text:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
text:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks:

  • Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

  • Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

  • Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

  • Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

  • Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

  • Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

  • Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

  • Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

  • Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

  • Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

title: Robotics Diagnostics Engineer
text:
We are looking for a robotics diagnostics engineer who enjoys getting to the bottom of complex system issues. You will investigate unexpected behaviour in our autonomous drone-in-a-box system, combining log and code analysis with hands-on experiments on engineering systems and bench setups. Bridging support and engineering, you will turn field reports into clear explanations, actionable fix recommendations and practical mitigations.

Responsibilities

  • Own investigations into system issues from new bug reports through to actionable findings, working with support to capture symptoms, operating conditions and relevant logs
  • Analyze logs and source code, develop hypotheses, and reproduce and isolate failures through targeted tests on engineering systems and bench setups
  • Assess issue severity with engineering, considering safety impact, system availability, affected versions and conditions, and uncertainty; escalate critical findings promptly
  • Give engineering clear evidence, reproduction steps and recommendations for fixes, and help verify that proposed changes address the underlying issue
  • Recommend and validate workarounds and mitigations with engineering, and give support clear guidance on their use, limitations and operational implications

Qualifications

  • Experience investigating complex software failures using logs, source code and systematic root-cause analysis
  • A practical approach to reproducing intermittent issues and designing experiments on engineering systems, bench setups or simulators
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain evidence, uncertainty, safety and availability impact, and recommended next steps to engineering and support
  • Curiosity, persistence and ownership when tackling unfamiliar problems
  • A degree in computer science, robotics or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience with drones, robotics and embedded software is a plus

100% · On-site

Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software.

  • Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines.

Hier is waar

Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Binnen onze projecten groeit de behoefte aan betere budgetcontrole en sturing op kosten. Ook het tijdig signaleren en beheersen van financiële en contractuele risico’s gedurende de hele levenscyclus van een project is cruciaal voor succesvol resultaat. Daarom breiden wij ons Cost Management-team uit. We zoeken een ervaren Cost Manager die het team wil versterken, verder helpen groeien tot een zelfstandige unit en zelf een leidende rol ambieert. Als Cost Manager ben je onderdeel van de unit Special Building Consultancy.

 

Als Cost Manager speel je een sleutelrol in het beheersen van kosten binnen complexe bouw- en investeringsprojecten. Jij zorgt dat projecten financieel realistisch en beheersbaar blijven van initiatief tot oplevering. Met jouw analytisch inzicht, projectervaring en overtuigingskracht adviseer je over kosten, waarde en haalbaarheid.

 

Je stuurt het integrale kostenmanagementproces aan en zorgt met betrouwbare en transparante kosteninformatie voor onderbouwde besluitvorming. Daarbij vertaal je financiële analyses en risico-inzichten naar concrete adviezen en bewaak je de toepassing van kostenbeheersingsmethodieken binnen projecten. Kortom een uitdagende functie voor een professional die inhoudelijke expertise combineert met leiderschap en wil bijdragen aan de verdere groei van ons Cost Management-team.


Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Ontwikkelen en valideren van integrale kostenramingen, kostplannen en -modellen in alle projectfasen;

  • Uitvoeren van haalbaarheidsstudies en benchmarkanalyses;

  • Analyseren van ontwerp-, uitvoerings- en materiaalkeuzes op kostenimpact en risico’s;

  • Beheren en verbeteren van kostenmodellen, kengetallen en benchmarks;

  • Beoordelen van kostenramingen, offertes en nacalculaties van interne en externe partijen;

  • Opstellen van risicoanalyses en uitvoeren van probabilistische kostenanalyses;

  • Monitoren en rapporteren over voortgang, afwijkingen en prognoses t.o.v. budgetten en realisaties;

  • Onderbouwen van investeringsvoorstellen en businesscases met financiële analyses;

  • Beheersen van kostenrisico’s en -kansen gedurende het project;

  • Contractmanagement in de realisatiefase;

  • Bijdragen aan uniforme werkwijzen, benchmarks en kennisdeling binnen het team;

  • (Mede)verantwoordelijk voor interne verbeterprojecten binnen cost management.

title: Software Engineer
text:
Do you want to work in a high tech environment where innovation is not a promise, but daily practice? At Salland Engineering, you work on technology for testing the chips of tomorrow. You will have access to state of the art tooling, modern test facilities and an environment where your own ideas, creativity and initiative are valued.

Salland Engineering is growing fast. This year, we are doubling our effective workspace, further expanding our testers and investing heavily in new technologies, including innovation in the field of photonics. As part of a global player in the semiconductor test market, we combine international strength with the freedom and short lines of communication of Salland in Zwolle.

As a Software Engineer, you develop C++ software, software calibration protocols and user interfaces for high tech electrical measuring instruments. These systems are used to test the most advanced chips behind the innovations of the future. This role is specifically focused on software development on the PC side.

Technical challenges do not put you off. On the contrary, you enjoy solving them and working closely together with your software, hardware and firmware colleagues to create smart and reliable solutions. Do you have a completed Bachelor’s degree in ICT, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering and already have several years of work experience? Are you familiar with C++ software development and do you feel at home in PC side software development? Then it is good to know that this position is not focused on embedded software development. Does it suit you to show initiative and work together with other technical colleagues on highly innovative projects? Then we are looking for you.

What you will be doing in your role

  • Designing, implementing and verifying drivers (PC-based) for high-tech instruments in test solutions for ATE (Automatic Test Equipment);

  • Designing, implementing and verifying calibration protocols to ensure the accuracy of the instruments;

  • Writing automated tests for hardware validation and developing user interfaces;

  • Keeping information up to date;

  • You are responsible for your own planning and report to your project leader / scrum master.

Were will you work

Nice to meet you, we are Salland Engineering from Zwolle!

For more than 30 years, we have been developing solutions and providing services for testing chips. Our technology can be found in everyday products such as smartphones, tablets and cars. text:

title: Working Student, Solar Regulation, Permitting & Contracts
text:
Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose and inspire thousands of drivers to transition towards electric mobility! Together with 450+ colleagues across Europe, we have the ambition to build Europe's best fast-charging network. We are active in 9 markets across Europe.  We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France, and the Netherlands, a testimony to our drive to offer the best charging experience to EV drivers!

The role

Our distinctive charging canopies create an opportunity to integrate solar panels (PV) into station design. However, this comes with a cost and certain operational complexity. We are looking for a working student to identify where solar panels create genuine legal, permitting or commercial value to help us review our strategy around this asset.

What you will do

  • Research national, regional and local rules on solar panels regulations impacting tenders and contacts for our European markets.

  • Review permitting frameworks to determine whether solar panels create explicit scoring, compliance or approval advantages and quantify those.

  • Review existing Fastned contracts to identify where solar panels is explicitly mentioned and document the requirements around it (energy generation, maintenance etc).

  • Make a clear distinction between green energy sourcing and on-premises solar panels requirements.

  • If time allows: research the influence that solar panels have on customers choosing to charge at Fastned locations.

Key deliverables

  • A country/region matrix showing legal requirements or clear advantages for tenders.

  • A country/region matrix showing proven advantages for permits.

  • An inventory of requirements around PVs in our existing contracts.

  • Bonus: evaluation of the value of PVs for our customers.

Who we are looking for

  • A bachelor’s or master’s student in law, preferably energy law, environmental law, administrative law, European law, real-estate law or construction law.

  • A genuine interest in renewable energy, electric mobility, infrastructure and the energy transition.

  • Strong ability to read legislation, official guidance, tender documents and commercial contracts.

  • Excellent written English and the ability to explain complex legal topics clearly to non-lawyers.

  • A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to source quality, citations and uncertainty.

  • Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets and the organisation of a large document set.

  • Fluency in another relevant language, such as Dutch, French, German, Spanish or Italian, is an advantage.

  • Experience with planning, permitting, public procurement, infrastructure or renewable-energy projects is an advantage.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
text:

Met jouw kritische blik, analytisch vermogen en verbetergerichte mindset help je onze processen elke dag een stap beter te maken.

  • Ondersteunen van verbeterprojecten binnen de organisatie.
  • Verzorgen van kwaliteitstrainingen en bijdragen aan het kwaliteitsbewustzijn binnen de organisatie.

  • Een informele organisatie met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's.
  • Een cultuur waarin samenwerken, leren en verbeteren centraal staan.

Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. title: Working Student / Werkstudent — Applied AI - Software Engineering

text:
The Role

You’ll help build real products across the software lifecycle: understand the problem → design → implement → release → improve. You’ll take ownership of well-defined tasks and features, with guidance, code reviews, and feedback from experienced engineers.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and design, and join customer conversations to understand requirements and share progress. We value curiosity, systems thinking, and a practical approach to turning ideas into working software.

You don’t need to know our entire stack. Bring solid foundations, some hands-on experience, and the motivation to learn by building.

What You’ll Do

  • Build with AI: use generative tools, work with our reusable components, and help test and evaluate AI-powered features.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions: explore solutions, discuss trade-offs with the team, and implement practical approaches.
  • Ship useful features: work with product and design to turn requirements into manageable tasks and working software.
  • Work across the stack: contribute to services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends, depending on your strengths and the project.
  • Build with quality in mind: write maintainable code, test your changes, and help improve reliability and performance with support from the team.
  • Collaborate with clients: join discussions, help clarify requirements, demo your work, and incorporate feedback alongside experienced teammates.
  • Communicate clearly: document your work, ask questions early, and keep the team informed about progress and blockers.

Required Skills

  • Currently enrolled at a university, ideally in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Practical experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and some familiarity with Node.js and React/Next.js. Personal projects, coursework, internships, and open-source contributions all count.
  • Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including how to structure and query data.
  • Familiarity with Git, APIs, debugging, and basic testing.
  • Interest in how systems fit together and a willingness to think through dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining your approach and documenting your work.
  • Initiative and follow-through: you can make progress on a defined task, use feedback, and ask for support when you need it.

Nice to Have

  • Some experience with Python, Rust, or Ruby.
  • Familiarity with caching, Redis, or event-driven systems such as Kafka.
  • First experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare, especially Workers, Durable Objects, or KV.
  • Exposure to Docker, GitHub Actions, or infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with AI tools, evals, reusable components, internal tools, or project templates.
  • Experience writing short technical specs or documenting design decisions.

These are useful starting points. You’ll have opportunities to learn them on the job.

Typical Stack

You won’t be expected to work with every tool from day one.

  • Languages / Frameworks: Node.js, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python; sometimes Rust or Ruby.
  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Airflow.
  • Messaging / Streaming / Workflows: Kafka, Temporal.
  • Cloud / Edge: GCP, Azure, or AWS; we particularly like Cloudflare—Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, and more.
  • Infra / Tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, IaC with Terraform.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Paid time off aligned with your working schedule, plus applicable public holidays.
  • High-end laptop, learning budget, and extensive AI tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with real products, regular feedback, and support from experienced engineers.

title: Controller (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Head of Finance – Teilzeit möglich
text:
Über Cellagon

Du hast in einem Startup oder bei einer wachsenden Marke gelernt, wie aus Ware Zahlen werden, und willst jetzt nicht nur berichten, sondern ein Unternehmen mitgestalten?

Cellagon ist 40 Jahre alt und tickt wie ein Startup. Seit 1986 machen wir Mikronährstoffkonzentrate, entwickelt und hergestellt in Deutschland. Unser Herz sind mehr als 15.000 begeisterte Partnerinnen und Partner in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz, die unsere Produkte persönlich weiterempfehlen.

So arbeiten wir: ein Team aus rund 35 Leuten, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und KI-Werkzeuge überall dort, wo sie uns die Arbeit leichter machen.

Was dazu noch fehlt: jemand, der unsere Zahlen in die Hand nimmt. Wir suchen dich als Controller mit Perspektive Head of Finance, in Teilzeit ab 30 Stunden oder in Vollzeit, remote mit regelmäßigen Treffen im Raum Düsseldorf.

Bevor du weiterliest, solltest du zwei Dinge wissen. Bei uns ist noch nicht alles fertig: Vieles steckt in gewachsenen Excel-Dateien, und genau dort kannst du vom ersten Tag an etwas bewegen. Außerdem ist unser Firmensitz in Altenholz bei Kiel. Du arbeitest remote. Wir treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich im Raum Düsseldorf, deshalb solltest du in NRW wohnen, idealerweise in der Nähe von Düsseldorf.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bewertest jeden Monat unsere Bestände an mehreren Lagerorten und gleichst sie mit unserem ERP-System ab.

  • Du übernimmst das Einkaufscontrolling: Einstandspreise, Preisüberwachung und Kalkulation je Produkt.

  • Du übersetzt unsere Einkaufs- und Produktionsplanung in Zahlungen und pflegst damit die Liquiditätsplanung.

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss gemeinsam mit unserem Buchhaltungsteam (DATEV) vor und steuerst ihn.

  • Du erstellst unseren monatlichen Management-Report mit Deckungsbeitragsrechnung und Kennzahlen.

  • Du ersetzt Handarbeit durch Automatisierung und KI, wo es sinnvoll ist.

  • Du koordinierst Budget und Planung mit den Fachbereichen.

  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in die Finanzleitung hinein: Jahresabschluss mit dem Steuerberater, Bankgespräche gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und fachliche Führung unseres zweiköpfigen Buchhaltungsteams.

Das bringst du mit

  • Studium in BWL, Finance oder einem ähnlichen Fach oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder Controller (IHK)

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling, alternativ in der Steuerberatung oder Wirtschaftsprüfung mit Mandanten aus Handel oder Konsumgütern

  • Erfahrung mit Ware: Bestände, Einkauf, Wareneinsatz und Kalkulation

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup, einem Scale-up oder bei einer Konsumgütermarke, idealerweise mit eigenem Lager oder eigener Produktion

  • Sicherheit im Monatsabschluss nach HGB

  • Praktisches KI-Wissen im Finanzbereich: Du setzt KI-Werkzeuge bereits für Auswertungen, Reporting oder Automatisierung ein

  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit DATEV und einem ERP-System ist ein Plus

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Freude an agilem Arbeiten, an Verantwortung und daran, Abläufe neu zu denken

Das bieten wir dir

  • Startup-Tempo – Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, keine Konzernschleifen.

  • Moderne Werkzeuge – Wir setzen auf Automatisierung und KI-Werkzeuge, und du bringst sie in die Finanzen.

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Anlagen- & Rohrleitungsbau - Wasseraufbereitung

Unsere Projekte liegen überwiegend in NRW, einzelne bundesweit. Schwimmbad-Fachwissen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Wer Anlagen- oder Rohrleitungsbau kann, lernt Badewassertechnik bei uns.

title: Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
text:
Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL in a system we built entirely ourselves. Full stack welcome.

Berlin or nearby, hybrid. Full-time, permanent. Start: as soon as possible

What this is about

Careship helps families find reliable support in everyday life: all across Germany, through self-employed caregivers and our own employed caregivers. Behind both stands a platform we built entirely ourselves, live since August 2026: a Python backend, an internal staff portal, an app for customers and an app for caregivers.

The system covers everything from the first inquiry to payroll: matching, scheduling, care budgets, billing with care insurance funds, payment processing and digital contracts, plus email, chat, WhatsApp and phone calls in one inbox. It is live, it runs the operations of two companies, and it grows every week.

This is why we are looking for the second person in our permanent engineering duo.

Your role

You work as one of two engineers on our system, with a focus on the Python backend: data model, business logic, APIs and the integrations our operations run on. If full stack is your thing, the rest is open to you: the staff portal in Next.js and our two apps in React Native. You share responsibility and cover for each other, in everyday work and during vacations.

  • You build features from the data model through the business logic to the finished API endpoint, and all the way to the screen if you want.

  • You work on core topics like the budget engine, billing, the payroll pipeline and matching. Logic where diligence really counts.

  • You maintain code in production that real people use every day: our operations team, caregivers, and customers with their families.

  • You work directly with product and the tech lead, no layers in between. Requirements arrive as fully worked-out specifications from our knowledge base, not as two-line tickets.

  • You get freedom and real responsibility: the system is brand new, much of it is taking shape right now, and you help decide where it goes. The roadmap includes shift planning, analytics, a marketing module and an ambassador platform.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL, on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage)

  • Portal: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, MUI, TanStack Query, generated OpenAPI client

  • Apps: React Native with Expo, shipped through the app stores

  • Integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet), Auth0, Aircall, WhatsApp and DATEV, plus payment and e-signature providers

  • How we work: AI-assisted. Specifications, code and reviews are created with AI support, as our everyday standard, not as an experiment.

What you bring

  • At least 3 years of experience in professional product development, more is a plus

  • Solid Python experience in production, ideally with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy or comparable frameworks

  • Confidence with relational databases and SQL, PostgreSQL in our case

  • You already code with AI support as a matter of course, ideally with real enthusiasm. For us this is a requirement, because it is how we work every day.

  • Diligence where mistakes cost money or trust: billing, payments, personal data

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

  • Appetite for a small team with a lot of responsibility and a direct line to the people who use your software

Nice to have

  • TypeScript, React, React Native or Next.js, if you also want to work on the frontend

  • App store releases and Expo EAS

  • Google Cloud, Googl

title: AI Tech Lead, Remote (based in Europe)
text:
Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. We're hiring our first AI Tech Lead to build the intelligence behind our coach: turning biometric and behavioural signals into personalised programmes that help people sleep better and stress less. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code.

What you'll be doing

1) Signal interpretation: Turn wearable and in-app data into recovery, stress and sleep insights, using personal baselines and trend detection.

2) Multi-device data: Normalise metrics across vendors, weight sources by reliability, and handle missing data and device switches.

3) Recommendation engine: Personalise protocol sequences by dose and timing with classical ML (e.g. contextual bandits, sequential recommenders or RL).

4) Feedback loops: Learn from real user behaviour and biometric responses which protocols work, and for whom.

5) Evaluation: Offline metrics, online experiments and production monitoring for every model and LLM feature.

6) AI platform: Own the roadmap, training and serving pipelines, data quality and architecture on our Python and Azure stack.

7) Technical leadership: Make and own the key architecture and modelling decisions, and write them down (RFCs, ADRs etc.) so the team can build them.

8) Privacy: Make secure handling of sensitive health data part of the design from the start.

9) Collaboration: Help product, design and marketing shape AI features and understand what the models can and can't do.

Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production

  • Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud

  • Time series, recommender systems, causal/uplift methods and strong statistics

  • A/B testing, model evaluation and production monitoring

  • LLMs and LangGraph (or similar) on Azure OpenAI, and knowing when not to use them

  • Experience as a tech lead or staff engineer, making technical decisions that a team of engineers followed.

  • Privacy-aware handling of health data

  • Based in Europe and fluent in English

  • Nice to have: bandits, RL or off-policy evaluation; health or wearable data; literature mining; AI in engineering workflows (coding agents, AI-assisted testing, CI).

Application process

Instead of a cover letter, please send us the answers to 2 of the following 3 questions together with your CV.

1) Tell us about an ML product you took from zero to production. What did you own, and what changed because of it?

2) You have a recommendation engine and want to know whether a protocol actually improves users' sleep. How would you measure that?

3) Tell us about a technical decision you made for a team that others disagreed with. How did you get alignment, and how did it turn out?
